children: Coinbase appointed Anthony Armstrong to its Board of Directors, effective September 1, 2026, and he will serve on the Audit and Compliance Committee.
Director; member, Audit and Compliance Committee
Board increased size from nine to ten directors; appointment following Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee recommendation

Will serve until the 2027 annual meeting or until successor elected or earlier death, resignation, disqualification, or removal; compensated under Non-Employee Director Compensation Program; entered into standard indemnification agreement; has platform accounts and uses products in ordinary course
Assigned to Audit and Compliance Committee
